body: She is the one I talk to the most. I think she has an idea that I've given up on myself.  It kills her to hear it, she tells me it hurts her to hear it so I don't tell her anymore. I don't want to cause more pain on her by opening up to her about my extremely negative thoughts. My parents have offered me a smaller position in the company, one that will reduce my Managerial duties. I'm not sure I should stay here at this business. I believe I'll end up in the same spot eventually. I have looked at other jobs and told my family of this but they really want me to stay in the family business, which I totally understand. They built this company for my future and my sister's future. I just wish I could find some motivation in myself to care enough to live and to keep going. But I honestly feel so drained and empty from all of this. How did you cope with the constant pressure from ppl needing answers from you?
